description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md to understand the 6-layer analysis framework and scoring system. (2) Analyze 1D and 1H candle data → conclude 'long' direction (higher highs/lows, price above MA). (3) Analyze 4H and 15M data → conclude 'trend' structure (EMA9>EMA21>EMA55). (4) Analyze 5M data → confirm valid long position (price above support ~73150, pullback held). (5) Analyze sentiment: funding rate 0.005 is within (-0.01, 0.01) → neutral; long ratio 62.3% is below 70% threshold → neutral; score sentiment layer as 0 or partial. (6) Analyze liquidation data → identify target zone 74800-75200. (7) Analyze 1M candles → detect that lows are DECLINING (73680→73650→73640), not forming higher lows; no confirmed breakout → trigger layer = 0/10, NO valid trigger. (8) Compute score (approximately 75/100 depending on sentiment interpretation, but ≤90 due to trigger=0). (9) CRITICAL TRAP: Apply the mandatory override rule '没有触发 → 不入场' (no trigger → no entry) → output signal='no_trade' regardless of score. An agent that sees favorable direction/structure/position and outputs 'execute' or 'watch' has failed to apply the hard-stop rule. The final signal_report.json must have direction='long', signal='no_trade', and a reason mentioning the missing 1M trigger.
